messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Sertraline carries a boxed warning, the FDA's most serious type of warning.
Antidepressants increased the risk of suicidal thoughts and behavior in children, teenagers, and young adults in short-term studies.
Pooled analyses of placebo-controlled antidepressant trials were conducted.
The trials covered about 77,000 adults and more than 4,500 children and teenagers.
The risk of suicidal thoughts and behaviors in people aged 24 and under was higher with an antidepressant than with placebo.
The risk varied considerably between different antidepressants.
The risk also varied by condition.
The highest rate of risk was in people being treated for depression.
The difference between antidepressant and placebo, per 1,000 patients treated, was:
Age (years) | Difference compared with placebo
Under 18 | 14 more patients with suicidal thoughts or behaviors
18 to 24 | 5 more patients
25 to 64 | 1 fewer patient
65 and over | 6 fewer patients
It is not known whether this risk continues beyond about four months of treatment.
Triples: [["Sertraline", "has warning", "boxed warning"], ["boxed warning", "is", "FDA's most serious type of warning"], ["Antidepressants", "increased risk of", "suicidal thoughts and behavior"], ["Antidepressants", "increased risk in", "children"], ["Antidepressants", "increased risk in", "teenagers"], ["Antidepressants", "increased risk in", "young adults"], ["Pooled analyses", "conducted of", "placebo-controlled antidepressant trials"], ["Trials", "covered", "77,000 adults"], ["Trials", "covered", "4,500 children and teenagers"], ["Suicidal thoughts and behaviors", "higher risk in", "people aged 24 and under"], ["Suicidal thoughts and behaviors", "higher risk with", "antidepressant"], ["Suicidal thoughts and behaviors", "higher risk with", "placebo"], ["Risk", "varied between", "different antidepressants"], ["Risk", "varied by", "condition"], ["Highest rate of risk", "in people treated for", "depression"], ["Difference between antidepressant and placebo", "per 1,000 patients treated", "14 more patients with suicidal thoughts or behaviors"], ["Difference between antidepressant and placebo", "per 1,000 patients treated", "5 more patients"], ["Difference between antidepressant and placebo", "per 1,000 patients treated", "1 fewer patient"], ["Difference between antidepressant and placebo", "per 1,000 patients treated", "6 fewer patients"], ["Risk", "not known to continue beyond", "about four months of treatment"]]
Relations: ["conducted of", "covered", "has warning", "higher risk in", "higher risk with", "in people treated for", "increased risk in", "increased risk of", "is", "not known to continue beyond", "per 1,000 patients treated", "varied between", "varied by"]
Answer:

completion:
conducted of: The subject action or study was conducted on or involving the object entity.  
covered: The subject study or data set includes or encompasses the object entity.  
has warning: The subject drug or product is associated with the warning specified by the object entity.  
higher risk in: The object entity has a higher risk of the subject condition or event.  
higher risk with: The object entity is associated with a higher risk of the subject condition or event.  
in people treated for: The subject risk or condition is observed in people who are being treated for the object condition.  
increased risk in: The subject entity increases the risk for the object group or population.  
increased risk of: The subject entity increases the risk of the object condition or event.  
is: The subject entity is defined or classified as the object entity.  
not known to continue beyond: The subject risk or effect is not known to persist past the time frame specified by the object entity.  
per 1,000 patients treated: The subject difference or effect is measured or expressed in terms of the object rate per 1,000 patients treated.  
varied between: The subject risk or effect differs or changes depending on the object entity.  
varied by: The subject risk or effect differs or changes depending on the factor specified by the object entity.
